semantics.definition: A small rounded link to one thing in No Origins, such as a meron, a project or a run, with its small picture, its name and a note. Given another site's address, it keeps the sign every outside link has: the arrow after its name, and a new tab. The usual name for this in design systems.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one chip every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Lead to one thing, showing what it is at a glance: a meron, a project, a run.

link.inside: a thing in No Origins: it opens here
link.outside: another site: the arrow after its name, opening in a new tab
